findings.message: <div data-composition-id="captions" data-start="0" data-track-index="3"> has no id, so Studio cannot use a stable edit target for its timeline and canvas controls.
findings.fixHint: Add a stable, human-readable id such as id="hero-title" or id="scene-1-card" to every timeline-visible element you want agents or Studio to edit.
findings.snippet: <div data-composition-id="captions" data-composition-src="compositions/captions.html" data-start="0" data-duration="84.69" data-width="1080" data-height="1920" data-track-index="3">

findings.message: <div> looks like captions but is not marked as such, so the timeline cannot group it on the caption track.
Multiple root-level HTML files with data-composition-id: captions.html, index.html. The runtime may discover both as entry points, causing duplicate audio playback.
findings.fixHint: A project should have exactly one root index.html with data-composition-id. Remove or rename extra files.

findings.message: Track 0 has 66 timed elements in this HTML file. Smaller sub-compositions keep timelines easier to read, iterate on, and diff.
findings.fixHint: Move coherent scene groups into smaller .html files and mount them from the parent with data-composition-src so the timeline stays easier to inspect, revise, and validate.
